name: RoamingAgreementManager
tagline: Every roaming partner, test and rate in one Power Platform app – from prospect to commercial launch.
description: A complete wholesale roaming app for Power Apps and Power Pages: partner register with TADIG codes, lifecycle pipeline with IREG/TADIG testing gates, country × service coverage matrix with priority gaps, IOT rates against caps, discount commitments, settlement estimate and what-if renegotiation. Works the moment it is dropped (demo mode) and binds to any agreement table in a few clicks.
features: 10 clickable KPIs and a needs-attention list
Lifecycle rules: tests required for launch, reasons for suspension/termination, required fields per stage
Drag and drop board with allowed / not-allowed feedback and a keyboard Move menu
Coverage matrix by country and service (2G … 5G SA, VoLTE, NB-IoT, LTE-M) with priority gaps
IOT data and voice rate caps, discount commitment forecast and net settlement estimate
Bulk steering and account manager, CSV export, undo
Phone, tablet and desktop layouts; keyboard and screen reader support
Power Fx outputs and events (OnSelect, OnChange, OnCreate, OnSave, OnAction, OnStatusChange)
controlType: standard (2 controls: RoamingAgreementManager data-set + RoamingAgreementManagerPortal Power Pages)
